text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, which makes sex discrimination between you extraordinarily unlikely. While an all-male panel may reflect a broader lack of gender diversity within the firm, it offers no evidence of bias against you based on sex. Raising the panel's gender composition would be unfounded and could damage your professional reputation.

The decision likely hinged on commercial factors, particularly the other candidate's highlighted client relationships, or internal networking. Instead of questioning panel demographics, send a polite follow-up requesting feedback focused strictly on the competencies, commercial criteria, and leadership attributes the panel prioritized.
